name: Private AI Readiness Audit
tagline: Evidence-led private AI infrastructure review with a read-only readiness collector and a fixed-scope remediation report.
audience: Founders and operators running self-hosted or private AI workloads who need a factual starting point before expanding inference, GPU, or customer-facing services.
pain: Teams lack a clear record of accelerator ownership, runtime compatibility, data-handling boundaries, and the highest-risk operational gaps.
offer: A fixed-scope review kit and operator-led assessment: intake, read-only evidence collection, architecture review, and a prioritized remediation roadmap with acceptance criteria.
deliverables: Buyer walkthrough, support boundary, preview, license, and manifest
delivery: Technical checkout catalog and local signed webhook-to-download proof passed. Public-edge download verification remains a separate external-buyer gate.
